messages:
nora: quick flag - p95 and p99 on the latency dashboard for /v1/chat seem inverted for small-sample slices (mobile-client). p95 > p99 in some cohorts.
kevin: ugh that smells like a sampling/aggregation edgecase. are these rollup t-digests?
nora: yep, rollup_type=t_digest in the console metadata. sample_count for those slices is 12-18.
maya: small counts + tdigest compression can make quantile queries noisy. but inversion implies incorrect merge order or stale metadata.
arthur: two likely causes: 1) some rollups are being downsampled with different compression params; 2) we've been dropping bucket counts for sub-slices when fanout merges happen.
olga: can you paste an example slice? I'll repro locally with the raw samples.
nora: slice: client=mobile, region=eu-west, endpoint=/v1/chat, time window last 15m. saved chart id=chart_8392.
kevin: repro steps: fetch raw events -> compute empirical p95/p99 -> compare to t-digest rollup pctl. if empirical p99 < rollup p99 but p95 > p99 that means t-digest merge artifacts.
telemetry-bot: note: t_digest compression changed from C=100 to C=50 on 2026-02-10T01:00Z across some old ingestion shards.
maya: that explains cross-shard merge mismatch. solution paths: normalize compression and backfill rollup variants, or change UI to gray-out percentiles when sample_count < 50 and show raw list instead.
arthur: I prefer both: telemetry normalizes future rollups (create rollup_variant metadata), but UI should warn at low-sample slices and surface raw-sample median+list for triage.
kevin: telemetry action: add rollup_metric `tdigest_compression` and `rollup_sample_count` to rollup headers. console action: show a little warning icon and tooltip: "Low sample (n<50) - percentiles may be unreliable. Click to inspect raw traces."
olga: I'll run a local repro and open telemetry#4777 with attached artifact.
maya: product/ux note: Ben asked that SLO tiles remain stable; we should ensure we only apply fixes for diagnostic panes first.
arthur: I'll also add a unit test for tdigest merge across compression variants.
kevin: I'll file console#2041 (low-sample warning + raw-inspect link) and telemetry#4777 (tdigest compression normalization + headers).
telemetry-bot: ticket telemetry#4777 created by olga.
kevin: console#2041 created and assigning to olga for the repro and to maya for UX copy.
nora: thanks folks. will monitor the chart after patches. end of thread.
